name: deploy_game
description: Deploy a built browser game from an uploaded zip archive and get a shareable play URL. Deploying also lists the game in the Higgsfield marketplace. The zip must contain at its root: logic.js (turn-based game-rules module) OR server.js (custom realtime server), plus index.html (the game page); everything else ships as assets. Package the game as a zip and upload it with media_upload (the .zip extension routes it as a general file), PUT the bytes to the returned upload_url, confirm with media_confirm type 'file', and pass the resulting permanent url as source_game. thumbnail (16:9) and favicon (1:1, square) are required https image URLs from generate_image — generate them first if the user gave none; they set the live-site favicon/OG and the catalog card (publish_game inherits them). The play URL and slug are auto-generated by an internal service — you do NOT pick them. Omit game_id for a NEW game; to UPDATE that game later, pass back the game_id exactly as returned. Never invent one. If an UPDATE deploy fails, report the error and fix the cause — NEVER retry without game_id: that silently creates a separate new game with a different URL instead of updating the existing one.

title.description: Public game title shown to users after publishing.

description.description: Short public description of the game, including gameplay style or objective.

thumbnail.description: Required https URL of the game thumbnail image, 16:9 (sets the live-site OG image and the catalog cover). Generate one with generate_image if the user gave none.

favicon.description: Required https URL of the game favicon image, 1:1 square (sets /favicon.ico and the catalog icon). Generate one with generate_image if the user gave none.

source_game.description: https URL of the uploaded game zip archive — the permanent url returned by media_upload/media_confirm for the .zip file.

game_id.description: Omit for a NEW game. To update an existing game, pass back the game_id returned by its first deploy. Never invent one.
